label: COMMIT BINDING ONLY. Bookkeeping. NO SCIENTIFIC CHANGES. No rerun. Nothing in this file alters any J3R measurement, threshold, control or outcome.
why_this_file_exists: the J3R receipts were written before the commit existed, so each carries git_head UNKNOWN. This binds them to the commit that contains them.
author: SpectraSynq
git_head_field_in_those_receipts: UNKNOWN - correct at the time of writing and DELIBERATELY LEFT AS WRITTEN. This file supplies the binding rather than editing immutable receipts after the fact.

reproducibility.why: scripts/j3r_synth_audit.py imports the J3Q machinery directly (load_rows, labels_for, score, the frozen recipe) rather than re-implementing it, and every module it reaches is in the tree from the capture commit c08793a onwards.
reproducibility.single_variable_enforced_by_import: the features, labels, topology, optimiser and recipe are the committed J3Q objects, so the one-variable claim is enforced by the code structure, not by discipline alone
